title: Same name, same file?
hook: Identical filenames do not establish duplicate contents.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that names can match while contents differ, so only comparing the contents shows a real duplicate

misconception: Two files with the same name are duplicates.
objective: Compare content identifiers instead of only names.
